title: Oakwood Hill - 4mi to downtown/Nissan Stadium
description:
Are you looking for an urban wooded adventure within minutes of downtown Nashville? Oakwood Hill is a hidden strip on the Northwest side of East Nashville, located across from a park with a beautiful view and trail, but also within a scooters distance of Hip East Nashville nosh & bars!

Oakwood Hill is a safe space for any and all people regardless of race, creed, sexual orientation or disability.

Permit #2022048427

The space
Fun and unique digs in East Nashville! Newly redecorated national park themed two story house complete with full amenities, including all linens and towels, a full kitchen, and huge outdoor hangout space.  Oakwood Hill is fully integrated with smart home technology and LED lighting for ambiance, powered by super fast fiber wifi.  We also provide smart televisions and a 4k projector with roku and digital channels included!  Spread out and enjoy the spacious hang out space with three living rooms included (one in the master bedroom). Also includes a large private front and back patio and yard, a rarity so close to the city.  The back yard provides true East Nashville hipster hangout style with electric wood pellet grill, fire pit, and yard games like corn hole and darts!  Relax and enjoy the cool vibes and surrounding nature, we have everything you need covered at Oakwood Hill!

Guest access
You and your guests will enjoy the entire house during your stay.  The front and back patio and yards are also private space for guests to enjoy!  We do not allow guest access to the laundry room or shed.

Other things to note
Oakwood Hill is an adult only experience. No children allowed.  Due to Nashville codes and permits requiring the booking guest to be 21+ we will need the booking guest to submit ID to the host prior to check-in. 

Enjoy the Sunset Experience, included with your stay.  Find the sunset kit in the house and trek just up the hill (.02mi) for a panoramic evening Nashville skyline sunset at Oakwood Park. We provide the chairs, blanket, and music so you can focus on making memories! Be sure to take lots of photos and leave a few too!
